text: I want to be passed around so bad, but my boyfriend just wants a monogamous relationship. It's 2024. Expecting to be with one person for your entire life is, like, unreasonable. I'm a young 18-year-old Latina. I'm trying to get my face blasted by multiple men. Like, I haven't even had a cookie in a bathroom stall. I have so much to live for. And you're telling me that I have to stay with this one guy because I love him so much. But there's literally guys out there with 13-inch feets waiting to destroy me. Damn, this one is rough. Guys, this is someone's girlfriend. Someone out there is trying to build a loyal, monogamous relationship with her. Girl, if you want to explore, go ahead. No one is stopping you. But at least be honest about it. Leave your boyfriend and go live that life. Why drag someone through your confusion? You can't call it love when you're already planning your next experience behind his back. And guys, please, be careful who you choose. So many men end up hurt not because women are evil, but because they ignore the signs. Listen to what she says, how she talks about relationships, what she finds normal. If she thinks loyalty is old-fashioned, or that trying everything once is her right, she's telling you who she is. Believe her. Don't try to change her, don't try to save her. Just move on. Find someone who values loyalty, who wants to build something real. Not someone chasing chaos and calling it self-discovery.
